description: This file defines a React component 'VerifiableCredentialBadge' that displays the state of a verifiable credential, including icons, status indicators, action buttons for verification, download, and copy, and a modal for detailed verification results. It also handles logic for fetching verification data, downloading VC documents, copying to clipboard, and rendering a verification modal with detailed results.

classes.description: Props interface for the VerifiableCredentialBadge component, defining input props such as VC status, data, IDs, display options, and styling.

classes.name: VerificationModalProps
classes.description: Props interface for the VerificationModal component, defining modal visibility, close handler, verification result, loading state, and error message.

methods.name: VerificationModal
methods.description: React functional component rendering a modal with detailed verification results, including overall status, issues, checks, and evidences.
